chunks: But he who is given his ledger from behind his back
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a person's book is given from behind their back on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, receiving the book 'behind the back' (waara'a zahrihi) signifies a state of shame and forced accountability, contrasting with the honor of receiving it in the right hand. This imagery underscores the psychological torment of the wicked who must confront their sins from a position of disgrace, a theme elaborated upon by scholars like Al-Tabarsi and Al-Kulayni.
